title: Point Mugu missile base near Oxnard

tellings.quote: military base there that near there that was very important at one time. Point Magcoo.

plain: Steve Colbern is a scientist who studies objects that people say aliens implanted in their bodies. He mentions Point Mugu, a military missile base near Oxnard, California, as a base that was "very important at one time." He tells Michels this in passing, without saying what happened there or where he learned it, and he does not say here why it matters to his story.
